name: Arch-Confessor Kyrinov
subtitle: Bearer of the Icon of Chiros

abilities.name: Bolt Pistol
abilities.text: [PISTOL]

abilities.name: Leader
abilities.text: This model can be attached to one of the following units: Battle Sisters Squad, Dominion Squad, Celestian Sacresants, Repentia Squad.

abilities.name: Icon of Chiros
abilities.text: While a friendly Adeptus Ministorum or Astra Militarum unit is within 6" of this model, each time you take a Battle-shock test for that unit, you can re-roll the result. In addition, that unit cannot be Battle-shocked while it is wholly within range of an objective marker you control.

abilities.name: War Hymns
abilities.text: While a friendly Adeptus Ministorum Infantry unit is within 6" of this model, that unit has +1 to the Attacks characteristic of its melee weapons.

abilities.name: Word of the Emperor
abilities.text: Each time a friendly Adeptus Ministorum Infantry model within 6" of this model would be destroyed, roll one D6: on a 4+, that model is not destroyed, has 1 wound remaining, and any Excess Damage from that attack is not applied to it.

abilities.name: Zealot
abilities.text: Each time this model or a model in its unit makes a melee attack, if the bearer's unit made a Charge move this turn, was charged this turn, or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.

composition: 1 Arch-Confessor Kyrinov model. This model is equipped with: 1 Bolt Pistol; 1 Mace of Valaan.
keywords: INFANTRY, CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, MINISTORUM PRIEST, ARCH-CONFESSOR KYRINOV

subtitle: Saint of Ophelia VII
factionLine: Adepta Sororitas • Order of Our Martyred Lady • Imperium

abilities.name: Bolt pistol
abilities.text: [PISTOL]

abilities.name: Mace of Saint Praxedes
abilities.text: [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]

abilities.name: Core
abilities.text: [LONE OPERATIVE] [FLY] [DEEP STRIKE] [FIGHTS FIRST]

abilities.name: Faction
abilities.text: Acts of Faith, Sacred Rites.

abilities.name: Saint of Ophelia VII [AURA]
abilities.text: While a friendly Adepta Sororitas unit is within 6" of this model, that unit can re-roll Battle-shock tests, gains Feel No Pain 6+, and adds 1 to its Hymn rolls (improves from 4+ to 3+).

abilities.name: Living Saint
abilities.text: When this model is destroyed, do not remove it from play. Roll one D6 at the start of your next Command phase: on a 4+, set this model back up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of enemies, with full Wounds. If it cannot be set up, it is removed permanently. This model can be returned to the battlefield up to twice per battle.

abilities.name: Martyrdom of the Mace
abilities.text: Each time this model fights, before resolving its attacks, you can declare a Martyrdom: this model's Mace of Saint Praxedes attacks are made with WS 1+ and gain [SUSTAINED HITS 2] this fight, but at the end of the Fight phase this model loses D3 wounds (this damage cannot be reduced or prevented).

abilities.name: Halo of the Emperor
abilities.text: Each time this model is targeted by a Psychic attack, you can roll one D6: on a 4+, that attack is ignored. This model also adds 1 to Battle-shock tests it triggers in enemy units within 12".

composition: 1 Saint Praxedes model. This model is equipped with: 1 bolt pistol; 1 Mace of Saint Praxedes.
keywords: INFANTRY, CHARACTER, EPIC HERO, LIVING SAINT, FLY, SAINT PRAXEDES
factionKeywords: IMPERIUM, ADEPTA SORORITAS, ORDER OF OUR MARTYRED LADY

abilities.name: Saint-Designate
